verdict.rationale: First-party docs say CodeRabbit appends a generated, plain-language summary grouped by change type to the PR description after each review, and posts a structured walkthrough comment at the top of the PR thread every time it reviews. Auto-review runs within moments of a PR opening, and range-specific summaries and diagrams help reviewers understand large diffs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration specifically of the summary and walkthrough quality.
